facts.fact: We Are Tech reports that on 24 February 2026 the higher education minister launched four platforms, bringing the sector to 73 digital services, as part of the national digital transformation strategy to 2030, measured against no strategy target.
The article says a draft law on digitalisation is being prepared as one of two cross-cutting pillars of the strategy, the other being cybersecurity.

systems.system: Higher education information system (73 digital services)
systems.owner: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
